items.stem: A deposit grows at a nominal annual rate of 8% compounded quarterly. What is the effective annual rate (to the nearest 0.01%)?

options.rationale: 8% is the nominal rate, not the effective rate under quarterly compounding.
This corresponds to semi-annual, not quarterly, compounding.

items.stem: For a bond priced above par, which relationship holds?

options.text: The coupon rate exceeds the yield to maturity
options.rationale: Correct: a premium bond has a coupon above its yield.

options.text: The coupon rate equals the yield to maturity
options.rationale: That gives a price at par.

options.text: The coupon rate is below the yield to maturity

options.rationale: Premium pricing does not require a call feature.

items.explanation: Correct: a premium bond has a coupon above its yield.

items.stem: Select TWO conditions required for Redington immunisation of a liability at a given interest rate.

options.text: Present value of assets equals present value of liabilities
options.rationale: Correct: PV matching is the first Redington condition.

options.text: Asset duration is much larger than liability duration
options.rationale: Durations must be equal, not larger.
Correct: greater asset convexity is the third Redington condition.

options.text: The portfolio holds only zero-coupon bonds
options.rationale: Redington does not require zero-coupon bonds.

options.text: Yields must be expected to fall
options.rationale: Immunisation guards against small shifts in either direction.

items.explanation: Correct: PV matching is the first Redington condition.
